name: Bestfriend Day — Hot-Air Balloon, Memory Wall & Scratch Reveal Edition
occasion: Friendship Day / Best Friend Celebration / Soulmate Gang
description: A heartwarming, interactive friendship celebration microsite featuring an animated hot-air balloon opening envelope, floating ambient music player, 3D flip polaroid memory wall with washi tape, real tactile scratch-to-reveal cards ('six little truths'), and an intimate handwritten letter with photo reels.
features: Floating 3D hot-air balloon opening sequence with personalized sticky note & wax stamp
4 aesthetic color palettes: Seaglass (Sunshine), Terracotta (Meadow), Lilac Dream, and Twilight Night-Mode
Ambient background song player with animated sound equalizer & playlist dedication
3D tactile polaroid memory wall with authentic washi tape textures and 3D card-flip notes
Interactive HTML5 canvas scratch cards with realistic foil scratch physics and confetti reveal
Handwritten letter section with cute sticker mascots and nostalgic photo reel
Real-time live builder with mobile, tablet, and desktop preview simulator
1-Click WhatsApp share with personalized heartfelt message and live QR code generator
Vanvi Moments authentic luxury gold-foil seal and watermark

defaultConfig.introSubtitle:
I made a little something
just for you...
defaultConfig.heroMessage: Every year this day comes around and I think the same thing: I got so lucky with you. So instead of a text this time, I built you a tiny corner of the internet. Stay a while, there's a bit to see.
defaultConfig.songCaption: press play — this one is permanently attached to memories of you.
defaultConfig.gallerySubtitle: every photo has something written on the back ✿
defaultConfig.galleryFlipHint: tap a photo to flip it ✿
defaultConfig.galleryPhoto1Caption: day one energy. we had no idea what was coming.
defaultConfig.galleryPhoto2Caption: still one of the funniest nights of my life.
defaultConfig.galleryPhoto3Caption: nothing happened this day. that was the best part.
defaultConfig.galleryPhoto4Caption: the trip we planned badly and loved anyway.
defaultConfig.galleryPhoto6Caption: proof we clean up alright when we try.
defaultConfig.scratchSubtitle: rub each one — there's something under it ✿
defaultConfig.scratchCard1Body: you notice something's off before I've said a word. that's the whole thing.
defaultConfig.scratchCard2Body: half my best memories are us doing nothing and laughing until it hurt.
defaultConfig.scratchCard3Body: years in and you still pick up on the first ring. no exit option, sorry.
defaultConfig.scratchCard4Body: you tell me the thing I don't want to hear, kindly. I always need it.
defaultConfig.scratchCard5Body: the small stuff — the worry from a Tuesday, the name I mentioned once.
defaultConfig.scratchCard6Body: no catching up needed. we just pick it back up exactly where we left it.
defaultConfig.letterBody:
I'm not great at saying this stuff out loud, so I made you a page instead — a song, our photos, and a few things I actually mean.

thank you for the years of picking up the phone, for the advice I didn't ask for and definitely needed, and for never once making me explain myself twice. you've seen every version of me and stayed for all of them.

I hope today is a good one. and I hope you know that whatever happens next, you've got a person in your corner permanently. that's me. I'm the person.
